x: The 1 Mile saw Pettet and Moody of the Police in front, followed by Bill Lucas, now demobbed from the R.A.F., and Tom Morrell and Stan Eales filled the next two places.
1 Mile : 1 Howell (Bel), 2 Edwards (S.), 3 Pettet (M.P.). 4 min. 37.8 secs. 2 Miles : 1 Nankivell (S.), 2 Clinton (Bel.), 3 Stimpson (Bel.). 9 min. 46.4 secs.

Stan Botwright won the 440 and beat both Pettet and Moody, who were running for the Police in this event. Derrick Burfitt, on his home track, turned out for us in the 1 Mile and won easily in 4 min. 32.3 secs.
